tasks.short: Develop the penetration testing process for in-scope systems.

steps.what: Agree which wireless networks and telecommunication systems the tests may cover.
Read prior notes and the current security constraints.
Develop the security penetration testing processes for these systems.
Place the named tests into a process outline with evidence headings.
Review the outline for gaps in the testing process.
Write the accepted process into the security store.

tasks.design: A template in {DOCS} places the tests she has already named into a process outline with scope and evidence headings. The penetration tester still develops the penetration testing process, reviews the outline for gaps, and writes the accepted process. The template does not decide which tests belong.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each engagement named its systems and evidence in free text, so one outline could not be filled from fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she names the test, the stop condition and the evidence to keep, a document template can place those fields under fixed headings.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing which wireless, data-network and telecommunication tests belong still needs her. A system with no agreed scope has no outline.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell that a complete outline still tests the wrong thing for this network.
tasks.altitude: The blank headings take less of the writing. She still decides the process and she still files it.

reach.task: Set the rules of engagement for a network test
reach.learn: Which systems and stop conditions a process must name before anyone uses it

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a document template can place already named tests, stop conditions and evidence headings into an outline. No cited product in this digest develops wireless, data-network or telecommunication test processes.

assumptions: Process fields are test name, in-scope system, stop condition and evidence to keep. She produces them in the develop step. If she has not named them, she writes the outline by hand.
The accepted process stays in the internal security store. Filing it is her write, not a second approval of that save.
unknowns: Whether her document store already has a process template she can configure without new code.
research_questions: How often is a new process mostly new tests, and how often is it the same tests on a new system list?

already_counted.description: Developing the process, reviewing the outline and writing the store record stay in a3, a5 and a6.

incremental.description: Update the outline headings when the evidence fields the store requires change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A process that is mostly new tests saves near 2, because she still writes almost all of it. A repeat of known tests on a new system list, after she has named them, saves near 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate a vulnerability assessment of the local environment.

steps.what: Read the vulnerability assessments of the local computing environments.
Flag rows missing a host, a date, or the enclave boundaries.
Evaluate which findings matter for these networks and infrastructures.
Record the evaluation in the security store.

tasks.design: A scheduled job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reads assessment rows in the security store ({OTHER}) and drafts a list of rows missing a host, a date or an enclave boundary. The penetration tester still evaluates what the findings mean for the networks and infrastructures, and she records that evaluation in {DOCS}. The job does not decide which finding matters.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessments arrived as narrative documents, so a job could not see a host, a date or a boundary as fields.
tasks.enabler_now: When the assessment already has those columns, a query can list the gaps without reading the finding text.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a complete row is a real weakness for this environment is still her judgement. A narrative with no rows falls back to her.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell that a finding inside the boundary is still harmless in this infrastructure, or that a low row is not.
tasks.altitude: Hunting missing hosts and dates takes less of the review. The evaluation and the record stay hers.

reach.task: Interpret a host finding in its environment
reach.learn: Which assessment rows are noise and which change the boundary

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a query can flag assessment rows that lack a host, a date or an enclave boundary when those columns already exist. No cited product in this digest evaluates what a finding means.

assumptions: Assessment row fields are host, date, finding id and enclave. The producer is the assessment she is given, not a new capture step by her. If the file has no such columns, she evaluates the document and the list is empty.
Recording the evaluation is her write. There is no second filing step.
unknowns: Whether the assessments she receives already use host, date and enclave columns.
research_questions: What share of assessments are row exports, and what share are narrative documents?

already_counted.description: Evaluating findings and recording the evaluation stay in b3 and b4.

incremental.description: Keep the required host, date and enclave columns current when the assessment export changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A narrative assessment with few rows saves near 8, because she still reads it. A large row export with the host, date and enclave columns saves near 16 after the list is drafted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and submit the internal report on security fixes.

steps.what: Prepare by reading the recorded results of security fixes.
Draft reports describing the recorded results of the security fixes.
Review whether the draft describes those security fix results.
Accept the report version that will be submitted.
Submit that accepted report to the internal system owner.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} drafts the report in {DOCS} from fix results that already name the asset, the fix and the retest result. The penetration tester reviews whether the draft describes those results. The security lead accepts that reviewed version, and she submits only that version to the internal system owner. The job does not decide whether a fix worked, and it does not submit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fix results lived in ticket prose, so a report could not be assembled without her rewriting each one.
tasks.enabler_now: Asset, fix reference, retest result and date are already fields, so a template can draft the report text from them.
tasks.still_hard: She still checks that the draft says what the retest showed. The security lead still accepts the version, and she still submits it. A result with no retest field is left out of the draft.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell that a retest marked passed still left the weakness the report must describe.
tasks.altitude: Copying fix rows into the report takes less of the writing. She still reviews the meaning, the lead still accepts the version, and she still submits it.

reach.learn: Which version is the one that may be submitted, and what voids it

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a template can draft a report from fix records that already hold asset, fix reference, retest result and date. No cited product in this digest writes security-fix reports.

assumptions: Fix-result fields are asset, fix reference, retest result and date. The producer is the person who recorded the fix, before this task. If a field is missing, that result stays out of the draft and she writes it herself.

The system owner is inside the company. The submit is an internal record, not a send outside the organisation. The security lead already accepts the version before it is submitted. Her acceptance time stays; it is not moved off the tester to create a saving.
A change to the reviewed report after acceptance voids the acceptance. She submits only the accepted version.
unknowns: Whether any copy of this report also goes to a customer or a regulator. That external send is not this design.
research_questions: How often does the security lead change the wording, and how often do they accept the reviewed version as it stands?

already_counted.description: Her review of the draft and her submit of the accepted version stay in c3 and c5.

incremental.description: Update the report headings when the fix-result fields the store requires change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A handful of fixes, several of them still in prose, saves near 12 because she rewrites those. A long list of fixes that already have asset, result and date saves near 26 after she reviews and the lead accepts.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose and run catalogue tests for a known class.

steps.what: Confirm the engagement still allows this class of test.
Read the techniques these tests are allowed to simulate.
Develop the stop line and choose tests for known cyber threat actors.
Execute only those named catalogue entries and record pass or fail.
Judge whether a failed check is a real weakness.
Record the finding she accepts in the security store.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} executes only the catalogue entries in the security store ({OTHER}) that she has already chosen, and it records pass or fail against the stop line she set. She judges whether a fail is a real weakness and she records the finding in {DOCS}. The job does not add a technique, and it does not file the finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each run was driven by hand from notes, so a job had no named entry and no stop line to obey.
tasks.enabler_now: Entries she has already written can be started as a batch and can stop at a line she set, without a model choosing the next technique.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the class and the stop line. A class with no catalogue entry is still hers to execute. A pass or fail is not itself a finding.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell that a failed check is a false result, or that a pass missed the weakness the class was meant to show.
tasks.altitude: Repeating entries she has already named takes less of the run. Choosing the class, judging the log and writing the finding stay with her.

reach.learn: How a named catalogue entry differs from a technique she has not authorised

evidence.claim: Aikido Security offers code, dependency and cloud scanning, autofix pull requests, and AI pentesting.
Of about 1,060 reports from one automated pentest agent, 130 were resolved and 417 were duplicate or informative.
Works-council consent can apply when security tooling observes staff.

assumptions: A catalogue entry has a check id, a class name and a stop line. She produces entries when she develops a process. The runner executes only entries she chose for this engagement. If an entry is missing, she runs that test herself.
The pass-fail log is a draft. It is not a finding until she judges it and writes the record. The runner does not send the log.
National rules vary. If the in-scope systems include staff machines, works-council consent is settled before the runner is switched on. The four hours below are catalogue upkeep, not that consent.
unknowns: Whether this company's in-scope systems include staff endpoints, which would change the consent work.
How many of her current tests already exist as catalogue entries with a stop line.
research_questions: What share of a week's tests are repeats of entries she has already written?

already_counted.description: Choosing entries, judging the log and recording the finding stay in d3, d5 and d6.

incremental.description: Retire or rewrite a catalogue entry when the class she authorises changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A class with few existing entries saves near 6, because she still executes most of it. A class whose entries and stop line she has already written saves near 12 after she judges the log.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still decides which tests belong, which findings are real, and what a fix-result report may say. Outlines, missing-field lists, report drafts and catalogue runs take less of the week. She still writes the process, the evaluation and the finding, and she still submits the accepted report.
skills_to_grow: Name the test, the stop condition and the evidence so an outline can be filled without her
State the host, date and enclave fields an assessment must carry before a gap list is meaningful
Keep a catalogue entry she has accepted separate from a technique she has not written down
role.ambitious_version: She could keep a standing catalogue that runs in each agreed change window and drafts a fix-result report the same day. That wider service is not this design. This design only drafts the repeatable parts of one engagement and leaves the judgement, the writes and the submit with people.
